## About SimUText

The course materials for BIOL 345 include a selection of interactive chapters and tutorials from **SimUText**, published by SimBio.

You can access SimUText through the SimBio Active Learning system using a web browser. You will need a computer that has a mouse and keyboard, and an internet connection. Campus computer labs or personal computers both work well.

To access the SimUText materials for *this* course, you must first register with SimBio using the **course-specific registration link**.

> **Registration link:** The course-specific SimUText registration link and course key will be posted in an announcement on D2L.

## Registration Instructions

### Choose a payment option

There are two ways to purchase access to SimUText: online with a credit card, or through the University Bookstore.

#### Option 1: Purchase directly from SimBio

This is the **easiest and least expensive option** for most students.

- Cost: **\$89**

- Purchase is completed online during registration.

- Online payment is required.

#### Option 2: Purchase through the University Bookstore

Use this option if you need to purchase SimUText using **financial aid**.

- Cost: approximately **\$130**

- Purchase a SimUText **voucher code** from the University Bookstore, either online or in person.

- If you purchase online, your voucher code will be sent to you by email.

- You will enter the voucher code instead of a credit card when you register with SimBio.

### Register for SimUText

#### Step 1: Prepare for registration

If purchasing directly from SimBio, have your payment information ready.

If purchasing through the University Bookstore, purchase your SimUText voucher code before beginning registration.

You will also need:

- your MSUM email address

- your Dragon ID

- the **course-specific registration link** posted on D2L

#### Step 2: Register with SimBio

Open the course-specific SimUText registration link provided in the D2L announcement and follow the instructions to create or access your SimBio account.

When prompted, enter your email address and Dragon ID.

If you encounter a problem identifying the correct course, the D2L announcement will also provide the **course-specific SimUText key**.

#### Step 3: Purchase access

When prompted for payment:

- **Direct purchase:** enter your payment information to purchase access from SimBio.

- **Bookstore purchase:** enter the SimUText voucher code you purchased from the University Bookstore.

#### Step 4: Access SimUText

After registering, you can access your assignments through the [SimBio Student Dashboard](https://simbioactivelearning.com/).

To complete SimUText assignments, use a computer with a **keyboard and mouse or trackpad**.

### Getting help

If you have questions about **which purchasing option to use or how SimUText fits into the course**, contact your instructor.

For **registration, installation, account, or technical problems**, visit [SimUText Support](https://simbioactivelearning.zendesk.com/).
